title: Can
description: OpenVinci-only schema for the Can low-level driver. Upstream's generator factory has no `class: "Can"` entry — Can_Cfg.c is hand-edited (vendor/as/app/platform/simulator/src/config/Can_Cfg.c). This schema captures the per-controller fields that appear in that C struct so OpenVinci can drive a Can_Cfg.c emitter when one is built. See docs/AUTOAS_NOTES.md §1.2 'Can'.

name.description: Controller name (matches the network name in Com/CanIf/PduR).

baudrate.description: Bus baud rate in bit/s. Default per Can_Cfg.c.

samplePoint.description: Sample point as percentage. Default per Can_Cfg.c.
